results.title: Sterling Bank backs Africa’s food push with N331.7bn HEART financing
results.description: Sterling Bank has disclosed that its financing across its priority HEART sectors rose by 39 percent to N331.7 billion in 2025, as the lender renewed its push to position agriculture as a major driver of Africa’s economic growth.
